records.purpose: Synchronous typed offline local-player equip: 1..16 unique slots (1.0 body slots 1..7; 1.1 adds weapon and multitool slots 8..21), fixed ASCII item classes, per-slot APPLIED/UNSUPPORTED/ITEM_MISSING/FAILED/UNAVAILABLE and applied count. Entire batch structural validation precedes engine calls; partial apply is not rolled back.
records.buffer_contract:
`sco_result (*apply)(sco_plugin* self, const sc_loadout_request* request, sc_loadout_report* report);`
Synchronous typed offline local-player equip: 1..16 unique slots (1.0 body slots 1..7; 1.1 adds weapon and multitool slots 8..21), fixed ASCII item classes, per-slot APPLIED/UNSUPPORTED/ITEM_MISSING/FAILED/UNAVAILABLE and applied count. Entire batch structural validation precedes engine calls; partial apply is not rolled back.
records.ownership: Caller owns full-size request/report and frozen item array (exact item_stride). No allocation transfer; inputs copied to bounded stack storage; pointers borrowed only during call. Only local player is targeted.
records.thread_affinity: Game thread only; WRONG_THREAD without output or engine access.
records.callback_context: No plugin callbacks. Internal game-pack backend callbacks are synchronous; caller pointers are not retained.
records.reentrancy: Recursive apply returns UNAVAILABLE with per-slot UNAVAILABLE; no nested backend call. Backend Start returns Unavailable and Stop is ignored during apply.
records.results: BAD_ARG for null/foreign/released self, short structs, zero count, wrong stride, nonzero reserved fields, duplicate slots or malformed class; TOO_MANY above 16. Structural refusals leave report unchanged. UNAVAILABLE for missing engine/verification/capability/offline admission, with per-slot UNAVAILABLE. OK iff all applied; FAILED for partial/slot refusals or guarded backend fault.
records.absent_capability: Absent table: query_service NOT_FOUND. Published table does not imply capability; production game.loadout.apply stays false.
records.cleanup: No pending requests, ownership tickets, persistence or unload rollback. Successful equip survives consumer unload. Table session-lifetime; stop withdraws after consumers unload. Backend fault disables apply until process restart; do not retry cached calls after shutdown.
limitations: Production typed engine equip/slot mapping is unverified and disabled. No XML loader fallback, account inventory or entitlements.
MSVC calling conventions/SEH and game acceptance not verified locally.
No claim of native corruption recovery; portable test catches C++ exceptions only.

records.ownership: Caller-owned full records; copied typed requests, owner-scoped process-unique job ids. One retained job per plugin, eight total. Local player only; no account inventory or XML.
records.thread_affinity: Game thread only; non-reentrant. No plugin callbacks.
records.callback_context: Tick-driven native work; no retained caller pointers or plugin callbacks.
records.reentrancy: Recursive mutation and backend Start/Stop refused while a callback owns the provider.
records.results: OK on accepted submit, observed status or cancellation; BAD_ARG for malformed extent/input/self, TOO_MANY for retained-job capacity, NOT_FOUND for foreign or unknown id, UNAVAILABLE for missing verified provider or admission, FAILED for terminal backend fault.
records.absent_capability: Query absent returns NOT_FOUND. Missing game.loadout.async refuses submit; table publication is not permission to mutate.
records.cleanup: Owner unload and stop cancel jobs. Session/admission loss or 120000ms timeout fails pending work. No retry or rollback. Fault disables mutation until process restart and retains uncertain native resources.
limitations: Opt-in native adapter is static/synthetic checked, not run in game. Visor unsupported.
Existing synchronous 1.0/1.1 methods retain their contract and remain unavailable without a synchronous backend.
